info.title: Rocoto API
info.description: Secure JMX management gateway for Java application servers. Every request requires authentication; write and exec are denied unless the policy allows them. 64-bit integers outside the IEEE-754 safe range, BigInteger and BigDecimal are returned as strings; byte arrays as base64.
